title: MAMAMOO: From Mr. Ambiguous to Starry Night
description: From their 2014 debut EP to Starry Night, Hip, Mamamoo+ and solo careers: ten questions on MAMAMOO's music and milestones.

questions.question: Mr. Ambiguous led MAMAMOO's June 2014 debut EP. What was that EP called?
questions.fun_fact: The song turned out to be a surprise success for the members, who had expected its very personal style to limit its reach.

questions.question: Um Oh Ah Yeh, MAMAMOO's 2015 sleeper hit, was the lead single of which EP?
questions.fun_fact: Solar, Moonbyul and Hwasa share writing credits on it, and the video has three members disguised as men, complete with wigs and beards.

questions.question: In August 2016, MAMAMOO split into a vocal pair and a rap pair for two singles. Who formed the rap pair?
questions.fun_fact: The rap pair released Dab Dab, while Solar and Wheein put out Angel on the same day, August 31, 2016.

questions.question: Which MAMAMOO song did the group re-record in Japanese for its first Japanese single in October 2018?
questions.fun_fact: The Korean original had led their 2016 EP Memory, and the Japanese single reached No. 11 on the weekly Oricon Singles Chart.

questions.question: Starry Night (2018) led which EP, MAMAMOO's first No. 1 on the Gaon Album Chart?
questions.fun_fact: That EP opened the Four Seasons, Four Colors series, which continued in July 2018 with Red Moon and its lead single Egotistic.

questions.question: MAMAMOO released Hip in November 2019, soon after winning which Mnet competition show?
questions.fun_fact: Hip went on to give the group its first No. 1 on Billboard's World Digital Song Sales chart.

questions.question: Which MAMAMOO member made her solo debut in April 2018 with Easy, featuring Sik-K?
questions.fun_fact: Easy peaked at No. 3 in South Korea, and her first studio album, In the Mood, followed in October 2023.

questions.question: Which two members formed Mamamoo+, the group's first official subunit, in 2022?
questions.fun_fact: Two Rabbits was one of the names the duo weighed before choosing Mamamoo+, and it ended up as the title of their first EP in August 2023.

questions.question: What was the name of MAMAMOO's first world tour, which ran from 2022 to 2023?
questions.fun_fact: It opened with three Seoul shows in November 2022, went through Asia and the United States, and closed with encore concerts in Seoul in June 2023.

questions.question: Solar starred in the 2024 Korean run of the musical Notre-Dame de Paris. Which role did she play?
questions.fun_fact: The part earned her a Female Rookie of the Year nomination at the 18th Daegu International Musical Awards in July 2024.

title: SHINee: The Odd Era of 2015
description: SHINee in 2015: the album Odd, its lead single View, the August repackage, a year-end award and the tour where View premiered.

questions.question: Ahead of View's release, which member said he was worried about how its new sound would be received?
questions.fun_fact: His worry came from how far the style strayed from their earlier songs, a contrast the album title Odd points to.

questions.question: View, the lead single of Odd, is built mainly on which dance genre?
questions.fun_fact: Its lyrics are about love sharpening every sense, and Billboard later named it among the greatest K-pop songs of the 2010s.

questions.question: Which SHINee member wrote the lyrics of View?
questions.fun_fact: He also helped write and compose Odd Eye, the R&B track that opens the album.

questions.question: Who created the choreography for View?
questions.fun_fact: Instead of SHINee's trademark sharp, tightly drilled moves, he built the routine around a relaxed groove that highlights how the members work together.

questions.question: In which country was the music video for View filmed?
questions.fun_fact: No video by a South Korean act drew more YouTube views in May 2015, and in it a crowd of female fans carries the members off.

questions.question: On which music show did View win its first trophy, on May 27, 2015?
questions.fun_fact: The song collected nine music show wins in all, the last of them on The Show on June 9, 2015.

questions.question: What title did SHINee give the August 2015 repackage of Odd, which added four new songs?
questions.fun_fact: Billboard's Jeff Benjamin heard its title track move from a beatbox-heavy hip hop opening to a funk chorus with horn blasts.

questions.question: Which award did View win at the 2015 Mnet Asian Music Awards?
questions.fun_fact: View was also up for Song of the Year that night, and later for the Digital Bonsang at the 30th Golden Disc Awards.

questions.question: Which member's ideas inspired the vintage, old-school costumes SHINee wore in the Odd era?
questions.fun_fact: By his account, Odd was also the first time the group helped steer its own album, down to choosing the concept and the lead single.

questions.question: SHINee first performed View live at the Seoul opening of which concert tour, in May 2015?
questions.fun_fact: It opened with three nights in Seoul in mid-May 2015 and wrapped up in Shanghai five months later.

title: K-pop Songs of 2015
description: Ten singles from 2015, from Crazy in February to Daddy at year's end: can you match each song to the act that released it?

questions.question: Which girl group released Crazy, the title track of its sixth EP, in February 2015?
questions.fun_fact: The EP topped Billboard's World Albums chart, and the ballad Cold Rain had come out first, in January 2015.

questions.question: Only You, the lead single of the March 2015 EP Colors, was released by which girl group?
questions.fun_fact: Black Eyed Pilseung composed it and co-wrote its lyrics, and it held No. 1 on the Gaon Digital Chart for two weeks.

questions.question: Shake It, produced by Duble Sidekick, was a June 2015 single by which girl group?
questions.fun_fact: Its first trophy came on M Countdown on July 2, 2015, followed by wins on Music Bank, Inkigayo and Show Champion.

questions.question: Remember, a July 2015 single co-written by Shinsadong Tiger, came from which girl group?
questions.fun_fact: It was the title track of Pink Memory, the group's second full-length album.

questions.question: Hoya of Infinite makes a cameo in the video for which girl group's 2015 hit Ah-Choo?
questions.fun_fact: Ah-Choo led the group's first EP in October 2015 and was still on major Korean charts in early 2016.

questions.question: Which YG boy group debuted with the single My Type on September 15, 2015?
questions.fun_fact: Its video drew over 1.7 million YouTube views in a day, and it won on Music Core on September 26, before the group's first official live stage.

questions.question: Which singer released Mind Your Own Business as the title track of her first full-length album, Vivid, in 2015?
questions.fun_fact: Show Champion gave the Vivid era its first music show win on October 7, 2015, just a week after the album came out.

questions.question: Which singer made her solo debut in October 2015 with I, an EP led by a song of the same name?
questions.fun_fact: Rapper Verbal Jint features on the title track, and the EP entered Billboard's World Albums chart at No. 1.

questions.question: Chained Up, the title track of a second studio album released in November 2015, is by which boy group?
questions.fun_fact: It took its first music show win on The Show on November 17, 2015, and the album opened at No. 3 on Billboard's World Albums chart.

questions.question: Who released Daddy, a single featuring CL of 2NE1, at the end of 2015?
questions.fun_fact: It borrows a hook from will.i.am's 2007 song I Got It from My Mama and became his third No. 1 on the Gaon Digital Chart.

title: K-pop Songs on the Phone
description: Texts to a crush, a phone promo, an ex who should not call and a wrong number: ten K-pop songs and releases tied to calls, texts and mobiles.

questions.question: IU's 2018 single Bbibbi is named after the Korean word for which device?
questions.fun_fact: IU released it partly to mark ten years since her debut, and it entered the Gaon Digital Chart at No. 1.

questions.question: Which group shot the video for its 2023 single ETA entirely on an iPhone 14 Pro?
questions.fun_fact: Made with Apple, the video was filmed in Barcelona, and the song itself is an upbeat Baltimore club track.

questions.question: Which boy band released Wrong Number as a single in 2008?
questions.fun_fact: It was the second of two promoted singles from the album Mirotic, coming after the title song.

questions.question: Call Call Call! was the lead single of the first Japanese EP by which boy band, released in May 2018?
questions.fun_fact: Released by Pledis Japan, We Make You climbed as high as second place on Oricon's weekly ranking and lasted 74 weeks on it.

questions.question: Which girl group joined BIGBANG on Lollipop, a 2009 song made to promote an LG phone?
questions.fun_fact: It borrows from the 1958 hit of the same name, and it spent four weeks at No. 1 on the Mnet music portal.

questions.question: Don't Text Me is a track on I Am, the May 2018 debut EP of which girl group?
questions.fun_fact: The six-track EP was led by Latata, which member Soyeon composed with Big Sancho.

questions.question: Which Super Junior member sang Whatcha Doin', a 2018 duet with Chung Ha about failing to reach someone?
questions.fun_fact: The Korean title translates as Where are you now?, and he co-wrote the lyrics with Min Yeon-jae.

questions.question: Which boy group set up a hotline with member voice messages before its November 2024 single album Last Bell?
questions.fun_fact: Demand swamped the line: within 10 minutes of the number going up, more than 10,000 fans got through and tens of thousands more calls failed.

questions.question: Which boy band released Don't Call Me, a 2021 song warning an ex not to phone again?
questions.fun_fact: The song was first meant for their labelmate BoA, and it led their seventh Korean studio album, which shares its name.

questions.question: IU's 2019 hit Blueming, about sending little texts to a crush, was a single from which EP?
questions.fun_fact: It debuted at No. 1 on the Gaon Digital Chart and won the Digital Daesang at the 35th Golden Disc Awards in January 2021.

title: STAYC: From So Bad to Cheeky Icy Thang
description: STAYC basics: what their name means, their sound, their fandom, a 2025 tour and their singles and albums from 2021 to 2024.

questions.question: What does the name STAYC stand for?
questions.fun_fact: Before the name was announced, the trainees were known as High Up Girls, after their agency.

questions.question: What was the name of STAYC's second world tour, which opened in Seoul in April 2025?
questions.fun_fact: Both Seoul shows, at Olympic Hall on April 12 and 13, sold out once general ticket sales opened.

questions.question: Before STAYC's debut, which term did their producers use to describe the group's sound?
questions.fun_fact: The term joins teen and fresh to stress each member's vocal color, and it later named a 2023 EP and their first world tour.

questions.question: What is the name of STAYC's fandom?
questions.fun_fact: STAYC met SWITH at their first fan meeting, Stay Cool Party, held at Sejong University's Ocean Hall on October 9, 2022.

questions.question: Which song led Staydom, STAYC's April 2021 single album?
questions.fun_fact: The ASAP video needed only nine days to hit 20 million views, and the song made it onto Billboard's K-pop 100.

questions.question: Which song gave STAYC their first music show trophy, on The Show in September 2021?
questions.fun_fact: It led their first EP, also called Stereotype, and its video hit 30 million views three weeks after release.

questions.question: Run2U, released in February 2022, was the lead single of which STAYC EP?
questions.fun_fact: It became their first album to debut at No. 1 on the Gaon Album Chart.

questions.question: With which single did STAYC make their Japanese debut in November 2022?
questions.fun_fact: Oricon's weekly singles chart lists Poppy's best position as No. 13, and the song also made the Billboard Japan Hot 100.

questions.question: What was the title of STAYC's February 2023 single album, named after its lead single?
questions.fun_fact: Described as a pop punk song with a hopeful message, the title track climbed to No. 4 on the Circle Digital Chart.

questions.question: Cheeky Icy Thang led STAYC's first studio album in July 2024. What is the album called?
questions.fun_fact: The album holds 14 tracks, and the group ran a pop-up store in Seoul to celebrate its release.
